title: Prism Current
creation_method: Independent deterministic G–Bm–C–D uplifting Trance game movement and new E minor–C–A minor–D answer movement for a 120-second stream master; sixteenth glass arpeggios, oscillators and seeded noise only, no sampled source audio or repeated first-minute loop

art_provenance.revision_reason: Replace the early cosmic translucent-prism scene with duohertz comic print while preserving five prisms and one connecting current
art_provenance.cover_prompt: Edit Image 1 into a NEW original SQUARE 1:1 cover-art candidate for duohertz track Prism Current. Image 1 is CONTENT reference only: preserve its specific idea of FIVE prism-shaped frequency diamonds strung on a single undulating current, shrinking as they recede toward upper right. Remove the cosmic night sky, translucent 3D crystals, aurora mist, lens flares, sparkles, gradients and realism completely. Image 2 is STYLE reference only for near-black ink, warm-ivory cut paper, coral and electric-cyan accent discipline, bold halftone print texture and graphic editorial rhythm-game energy; do not copy its circular rings or radial composition. Make five large flat angular paper prisms like folded diamond kites, from huge in left foreground to small at upper right. A single strong electric-cyan zigzag current visibly threads through the CENTER of every prism; alternating coral triangular faces distinguish each prism from the warm-ivory body. An off-center diagonal layout, a few purposeful warm-yellow beat marks, sparse large halftone patches, quiet near-black lower fifth for later local title overlay. Silhouette clear at 100px, all ages, no strobe. No realistic sky, galaxy, glass, crystals, water, plants, circles, paper planes, characters, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or copied game art.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Edit this newly redrawn original Prism Current square cover into a NEW HORIZONTAL roughly 1.9:1 duohertz social card. Preserve five flat folded warm-ivory/coral frequency prisms shrinking toward upper right, a single vivid electric-cyan jagged current visibly threading through the center of each, small warm-yellow beat marks, near-black ink and restrained large halftone. Recompose the prism current across the RIGHT two-thirds with its full five-prism sequence identifiable; keep a quiet near-black LEFT third. Add EXACTLY TWO crisp fully readable English text lines on the left: 'duohertz' all lowercase in electric cyan, and 'Prism Current' in larger warm ivory. Spell both EXACTLY, do not truncate. Design a wide card rather than stretching the square. No other words, letters, numbers, galaxy, sky, realistic glass, water, plants, paper planes, circles, characters, logos, watermark or copied game art.

previous_art_provenance.cover_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original square, text-free album-cover background for an internal duohertz electronic rhythm-game candidate
Primary request: Create distinctive art for “Prism Current”, an uplifting all-ages Trance track. Show a suspended procession of translucent faceted prisms passing a soft continuous wave of violet and mint light from one prism to the next, like a current of sound moving horizontally then rising gently. Let tiny starlike frequency particles emerge at each transfer point. This is an abstract musical scene, not literal crystals for mining or a fantasy weapon.
Style/medium: polished contemporary editorial electronic album illustration with subtly refracted light, clear big shapes and fine ambient particles, welcoming to children and adults, legible at thumbnail size.
Composition/framing: square; main prism chain runs across the upper and middle image; lower third is calm dark indigo space for a separate local title overlay.
Color palette: cool violet, mint, icy white, peach glints, deep indigo.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, people, characters, weapons, vehicles, food, red neon city, flashing or strobing stripes, copied game imagery, rising helix, racing ribbons, paper fins, copper lanterns, citrus tiles, interlocking circular rings, sunset glass horizon or aurora stepping stones.
